featured_reviews.review_text:
An Exceptional Leg Day training with Nomaan Mukri at Plus Fitness Gym

I had a leg day session with Nomaan at Plus Fitness, and I am absolutely impressed by the quality of the training. I can't recommend him enough to anyone serious about making real progress.
The session began with a comprehensive 30-minute warm-up. I'll be honest, I never realised how much of a difference a proper warm-up could make until today. Nomaan's approach made my muscles feel activated and ready, which completely changed the effectiveness of the entire workout.
When we got into the main leg exercises, Nomaan's expertise was immediately apparent. He guided me through multiple variations and masterfully showed how a small change in angle or form could target a completely different part of the muscle. It was a lesson in anatomy as much as it was a workout! He has a gift for pushing you beyond your comfort zone in the most encouraging way. With his guidance, I was able to safely increase both my repetitions and the weight, achieving more than I thought I was capable of.
Throughout the session, Nomaan shared invaluable knowledge about how to stabilise progress and ensure long-term gains. It's clear he is incredibly well-versed in how different bodies should be trained, considering factors like gender, age, and overall health to create a truly personalised experience.
We finished with a fantastic stretching session that left me feeling strong and mobile, not just exhausted. What truly sets Nomaan apart is his professionalism combined with a genuinely humble and supportive attitude. He makes you feel like a teammate on your fitness journey.
If you want a trainer who is not just a rep-counter but a true teacher and motivator, you must train with Nomaan. My perspective on training has completely changed for the better!

I'm writing this review to express my concern about the steadily declining maintenance standards at this gym. Given the current condition of the facilities, I strongly feel that the monthly membership fee of ₹11,000 should be reduced to ₹10,000.

There are several persistent issues that have been left unaddressed:

No personal locker facility is available.

Tissue papers are often missing in the washrooms.

Cleanliness is below acceptable standards, with cockroaches frequently spotted on the floor.

These issues reflect poorly on the quality of service, especially considering the premium fees being charged.

Additionally, on May 7th, I visited to renew my membership and requested if my membership could be paused for June, as I’ll be traveling. The receptionist contacted the owner but couldn't reach him. I was told I couldn’t begin workouts until a decision was made. Despite clearly stating that I was still willing to renew, I was denied access. The trainer, Sahil, and the receptionist were extremely rude and made me wait unnecessarily.

As a long-standing member, this kind of treatment was very disappointing and showed a complete lack of customer support and respect. I considered not returning, but out of habit, I did only to realize that the attitude and service were simply not worth it.

Thankfully, I’ve now joined Gymathon in Mazgaon. They offered a 1.5-month free trial without any hassle and activated my membership exactly as requested, starting at the end of June. They also provide personal lockers and a steamer facility all at the same ₹11,000.

So, in hindsight, I’m grateful for the poor experience here it led me to a far better one elsewhere.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a member of this gym for almost 3 years, and honestly, I am extremely disappointed with how they handled a serious medical situation.

On 15th April, I tore my ACL while playing football and later underwent surgery on 27th April. Since I will not be able to train or lift weights for several months, I requested the gym to temporarily freeze my membership period. I even submitted all MRI reports, medical documents, and surgery details immediately when asked.

Instead of showing empathy or trying to genuinely help, the management kept delaying the process for days and only offered options that financially benefited the gym:-

1.Pay ₹2500 to convert my account to a non-member account.
2.Renew next year’s membership and then they will “give 1 month free.”

To be clear, I never asked for a refund or cancellation. I only requested that my current membership period be paused due to a major surgery.

What disappointed me most was the lack of professionalism and transparency. Different things were communicated on different calls, promises of manager callbacks kept getting delayed, and every solution revolved around extracting more money instead of supporting a loyal customer during a genuine medical emergency.

The shocking part is that the gym does advertise account freezing options in their own marketing communications, yet during an actual medical situation they suddenly claim “there is no such policy.”

If this is how a loyal 3-year customer is treated after ACL surgery, new customers deserve to know what kind of support they can realistically expect once the membership payment is done.

I hope the owners take this feedback seriously and improve how they handle medical cases and customer support in the future.
